children: Pyrophyte Acquisition II agreed to merge with Sakuu in an all-stock transaction valuing the battery technology company at $600 million, with 60,000,000 new shares to be issued at a $10.00 per-share equivalent. Pyrophyte will domesticate from the Cayman Islands to Delaware and be renamed Sakuu Holdings after closing, which is subject to shareholder approvals, SEC effectiveness, exchange listing, and at least $30 million in net closing cash. Related agreements include sponsor voting and expense backstop commitments, a 12-month lock-up for certain Sakuu holders with an early release at $12.00, shareholder support agreements to secure consents, and registration rights to facilitate post-close liquidity.

: Up to 5 years for forfeiture triggers; up to 1 year lock-up

: Align insiders and support trading stability
Agreement 4: Sakuu Shareholders to Deliver Support Agreements to Approve Business Combination
Agreement 5: New Pyrophyte to Grant Registration Rights to Sponsor and Key Holders at Closing
: Provide resale registration for key holders
